# Peal Sealed Auction, pinned copy

Unmodified files from [Peal Sealed Auction](https://github.com/Adityaakr/peal-sealed-auction) at commit
`bc021bd` (Apache-2.0), the contracts as deployed on `qorechain-diana`. The vault's tests run against
them; the vault itself imports only the small interface in `contracts/src/interfaces`. Do not edit:
`test/vault.test.ts` checks every file against the hash recorded in `SHA256SUMS`.
